Review Text: I just wanted to say thank you for an amazing experience!! Our Delta airline flights were delayed by 8 hours and the first day of our trip to Friday Harbor was not what we had expected. We got stuck in Seattle and missed our original transportation by car and ferry but Friday Harbor Seaplanes came to our rescue. Michelle was absolutely amazing and got us booked on the first flight out the following morning so we didn’t waste another moment of our trip. She arranged a shuttle to pick us up at the hotel we booked which was also quite the task as many hotels were completely booked up but we finally found one and Friday Harbor Seaplanes accommodated us and got us to the airport and flew us in to Orcas Island. I was really impressed by our pilot and how well he flew the plane. I was a bit nervous and I tend to get motion sickness and he made the flight very enjoyable and even checked in with me during the flight to see how I was feeling. I felt he took slight turns a bit more slow and careful with me in mind and it was very appreciated. My friend also had her baggage delayed by Delta Airlines for 2 days and Michelle was so kind to try and help us by arranging for the airport to deliver the luggage to them so they could bring it to the Friday Harbor dock on one of their daily flights. Unfortunately Delta was being lame and they wouldn’t do it, but the fact that Friday Harbor Seaplanes was willing to help us went above and beyond our expectations. What amazing customer service! I hope to one day visit the islands again and without a doubt I will use Friday Harbor Seaplanes again. They treated us like family!! Thank you! I wholeheartedly recommend this business. They are all great people and do an excellent job!

Review Title: Seaplane flight R/T to  Friday Harbor
Review Text:
Excellent Adventure! We chose Friday Harbor Seaplanes for round trip flights during a five day visit to Friday Harbor. Top to bottom excellent experience with this company. Great communication during booking and subsequent phone calls, timely pickup and return service to SeaTac Airport, friendly ground staff, and first rate pilots. Loved flying in the vintage De Havilland seaplanes! Flight altitudes allows the pilot to easily maneuver airplane to view sights. Headphones provided to two-way communication.

Things to be aware of for this flight: the seaplane dock at Friday Harbor Port is quite a walk from town (1/2 mile +/-), to our hotel at Bird Rock, and you must haul your own luggage. I am glad we heeded the advice to pack softside duffles with shoulder straps (and the correct weight: 30 LB per passenger includes carry on bags) as a roller bag would be rough going on the wood slat dock. Also small planes are buffeted by thermals and wind and can be 'interesting' for the motion sickness prone (me - no worries I was fortified with medication from 3 days on boat tours), air sick bags provided just in case. Mostly smooth flights and I made the pilot aware of my tendencies.

At the time of our booking the R/T seaplane was a less expensive option than renting a car and taking the ferry, besides the stress of navigating Seattle traffic and the time involved. A car was not required for us at Friday Harbor as most of our activities were at the docks, and there were several rental options on the island.

All things considered an excellent company and experience, I would highly recommend!

Saw glaciers from what appeared to a few feet below the plane.  On the return trip the weather was drizzly and overcast so we flew back from the lodge to Seattle all the way along the Pacific coast at about 500 feet Saw amazing scenery from mountains to beaches to pods of Orcas.  As we passed over Seattle headed to our water landing, we flew by the needle and the waterfront of Seattle.  Very cool!  For a flatlander from Florida, this was an absolute joy of a trip and flight.  Highly recommend these folks for any flying excursions.

Review Text: Our family took Northwest Seaplanes from Renton to Friday Harbor, then to Nootka Sound, and finally back to Renton. Jason piloted us to and from Nootka Sound.  The flight across Vancouver Island was simply amazing, the views were almost surreal. The headphones were a great addition to the flight as they allowed us to talk among ourselves during the flight.  Definitely a great way to fly to Vancouver Island and Shane and Jason make sure that your flight is very comfortable.  We will definitely take Northwest Seaplanes in the future.
